notes.title: Jiraiya Free Russian Update & Steam Price Match (reduction)!
notes.content:
Salutations readers :D,

Jiraiya now supports the Russian language and the visual novel's price has been reduced on Steam to match our other distribution platforms.  Thank you for the feedback, it allowed us to make a better decision in terms of pricing.

Sincerely,

Brave Rock Games
